THE p.540 GATE (ruling 14: Pars II closes) falls at the end of this row: ¶60 (Vers. 38, 'Et quia talis praelatus et doctor libenter auditur') runs from 539R across the top of both columns of p.540 and ends at ~0.13 ('…et hauriet salutem a Domino ».'); CAPITULUM XXII. stands full measure at ~0.155; below it on 540L the t1 'Pars III. De passionis medicamento agitur dupliciter.', ¶1 'Appropinquabat autem dies festus azymorum etc.', the italic t2 'Primo, de passione quoad quatuor antecedentia.', un-numbered text and the t3 'Primo, de machinatione proditoris dicuntur quatuor.' (the next interval's). Cap. XXI's last ¶ is 60, NOT ~54+. p.540 n.1 ('accelerare¹', 540L top band) is this row's; n.2 on is Cap. XXII's (anchors read, register not counted). ~3.9 pp.
